title: Early Cycle Charge Trajectory Generative Prediction and Full Life Cycle Health Management of Iron-Chromium Flow Batteries Based on FlowBD-E1
abstract: arXiv:2608.14637v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-duration stationary energy storage requires batteries whose degradation can be detected before substantial capacity loss has accumulated. Iron-chromium redox flow batteries are attractive for this role because they use abundant and low-cost active species, yet their operation is shaped by slow chromium kinetics, hydrogen evolution, membrane crossover and electrolyte imbalance. These coupled processes gradually reshape the full charge voltage/current (V/I) trajectory, but most battery prognostic studies either focus on lithium-ion cells or compress ageing into scalar capacity and state-of-health (SOH) labels. Here we study an industrial 33 kW Fe-Cr redox flow battery and introduce FlowBD-E1, an early-cycle generative forecasting framework that predicts complete future charge V/I trajectories from only the first few cycles. translated_title: 基于FlowBD-E1的铁铬液流电池早期循环充电轨迹生成预测与全生命周期健康管理
translated_abstract: 长时间固定式储能需要能够在显著容量损失累积之前检测电池退化的电池。铁铬氧化还原液流电池因其使用丰富且低成本活性物质而具有吸引力，但其运行受到缓慢的铬动力学、析氢反应、膜交叉和电解液失衡的影响。这些耦合过程逐渐重塑完整的充电电压/电流（V/I）轨迹，但大多数电池预测研究要么聚焦于锂离子电池，要么将老化压缩为标量容量和健康状态（SOH）标签。在此，我们研究了一台工业规模的33 kW铁铬液流电池，并引入了FlowBD-E1，一种早期循环生成式预测框架，仅利用前几个周期即可预测未来完整的充电V/I轨迹。该模型结合了多尺度卷积编码器、生命周期Transformer和年龄感知FiLM解码器，以及……
tldr: 该论文提出了FlowBD-E1，一种基于早期循环数据生成预测铁铬液流电池全生命周期充电轨迹的框架，实现了提前健康管理，克服了传统方法仅依赖标量容量或SOH的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FlowBD-E1, a generative framework that predicts full-lifecycle charge trajectories of iron-chromium flow batteries from early cycles, enabling proactive health management beyond scalar capacity or SOH labels.
